## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm run check` passes
- [ ] Tests added or updated (and `pnpm run verify:package` if installation is affected)
- [ ] Docs and comments updated (`docs/`, README, CHANGELOG under "Unreleased")
- [ ] No new dependency without a documented purpose in `docs/decisions.md`
- [ ] No credentials, connection strings or real schema names in code, tests or screenshots
